name: osnap: snap to all poles
from: wellFormedBezier(s) ? [{ at: s.poles[0], kind: 'end' }, { at: s.poles[s.poles.length - 1], kind: 'end' }] : []
to: wellFormedBezier(s) ? s.poles.map(at => ({ at, kind: 'end' as const })) : []

name: select: no bezier aside
bezierError: collinear ignored
from: if (p.every(q => Math.abs((q[0] - p[0][0]) * uy - (q[1] - p[0][1]) * ux) < EPS))
